title: A queue that never drains
stimulus: Tasks arrive faster than workers complete them. Describe the evidence you need to distinguish a burst from sustained overload, propose a bounded-work policy, and explain which demand it rejects or delays.
structural_context: Admission and backlog growth without assuming unlimited storage.

hints.content: Identify the precise assertion you need to justify before proposing a solution.
Look for a change in assumptions that would make your proposed reasoning fail.

validation.reason: Synthetic design fixture; requires answer-key and source review before real assessment use.
